law_generator: m_i=(case+3*i)%7-3; slope_i=((2*case+i)%5-2)/5; L_ij=((case+2*i+j)%5-2)/10 for j<=i with diagonal augmented by 1; S=L L^T
cost_units: each exact rational add or multiply = 1; each memo/cache lookup = 1; source/scope comparisons = 1; cache insertion = 1; reporting and input parsing excluded equally; no wall-time claim
reuse_arm: construct affine moment polynomial once for each degree, then evaluate at five marks
recompute_arm: construct constant-mean moment polynomial separately at each of five marks
acceptance: same exact values at every mark, both arms within common budget; record costs even when reuse loses
scope: finite deterministic held-out arithmetic-cost experiment; canonical utility remains UNMEASURED; no field certification; no independence credit
held_out_exposure: generator and IDs fixed before implementation; generated numerical cases first consumed only by final report; implementation tests use development IDs or explicit independent fixtures
